citation.ref: Epoch AI, How much energy does ChatGPT use?

provenance: 0.3 Wh per typical short (~500 token) answer, 2.5 to 40+ Wh for long queries, the LED-bulb comparison, and ~28 kWh/day per US household are Epoch AI's figures; the ~50 GWh (outside estimates 33 to 60) for a GPT-4-class training run is from Epoch AI's energy hub and is marked an estimate in-app. points = the four-rung scale ladder in Wh: x=1 one answer (0.3), x=2 a year of asking at 10/day (10 x 365 x 0.3 = 1,095 Wh, about 90 phone charges at ~12 Wh), x=3 the world's day of asking (2.5e9 answers x 0.3 Wh = 750 MWh, about 27,000 households), x=4 one frontier run (50 GWh, about 67 world-days). Rungs 2 to 4 are DERIVED and labeled so in-app; 2.5B answers/day is an OpenAI figure as reported by press (mid-2025). CO2 stays an analogy: no Wh-to-grams conversion (grid-mix dependent). Not peer-reviewed.
